description: This file defines the EmploymentStatus class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the reporting filter fields. The class extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable, providing functionality to add filtering conditions to a query concerning employee employment statuses, retrieve entity aliases, and normalize the value of the employment status for reporting purposes.

classes.name: EmploymentStatus
classes.description: Represents a filter field for employee employment status within report generation, providing methods to modify query filters based on employment status, retrieve related entity aliases, and normalize values for reporting.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a WHERE condition to the query builder to filter employees by employment status if the operator is EQUAL and the value (X) is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the list of entity aliases involved in this filter, in this case, ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the internal value (X) into an array with 'id' and 'label' representing the employment status, fetched via EmploymentStatusService. Returns null if the status cannot be found.
